title: Mixed stage types and RM allocation under a budget
question: If the stage types are chosen per stage (Kerr phase, triplets, both, skip) under a common RM budget, is it better than the uniform cascade of E040 at the same RM?
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation

value_filter.changes_next_step: yes: positive makes the mixed cascade the reference at that RM; negative closes candidate A
value_filter.answered_in_literature: no in explicit form (docs/literature_check.md, level: abstracts)
value_filter.needed_for_main_claim: no for the main claim; it is a candidate improvement

decision_if_positive: report the mixed cascade and the map of stage types by position; it enters E043
gate: runs only if results/gate_e040.json says the cascade beat the one-step triplets, or if results/gate_e040_decision.json has run_e041: true (the author's decision)

uniform.note: the E040 family (identical T stages) with any integer K_th in 1 .. M^2 and M in 2 .. 16, so that it reaches the same 60 configurations per level as the mixed arm (with the planned K_th set only 14-16 distinct configurations fall in a level window)

budget_note: equal tuning budget: both arms get 60 configurations x 2 seeds x 20k, top 4 x 3 x 60k, top 2 x 5 x 200k per level; the uniform arm is the control of the mixed one

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.mixed_better: A (mixed) beats the uniform cascade at level K if its S3 best by validation is higher in test by >= max(1.5 p.p., 2 x the seed spread of this experiment's control) with non-overlapping seed intervals, on at least 2 of 3 levels; otherwise A is closed
rule_draft.report: map of stage type by position for the top 10 configurations of S1 per level
